preconditions.expression: root is None or isinstance(root, TreeNode)
preconditions.description: The input root must be either None or a valid TreeNode instance.

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(node, TreeNode) for node in [root] + [node.left for node in [root] if root] + [node.right for node in [root] if root]) if root else True
preconditions.description: If root is not None, all nodes in the BST must be valid TreeNode instances with left and right attributes.

preconditions.expression: all(node.val is not None and isinstance(node.val, int) for node in [root] + [node.left for node in [root] if root] + [node.right for node in [root] if root]) if root else True
preconditions.description: Every node's value must be a non-None integer.

preconditions.expression: all(node.left is None or node.left.val < node.val for node in [root] + [node.left for node in [root] if root] + [node.right for node in [root] if root]) if root else True
preconditions.description: The BST property must hold: for every node, all values in its left subtree are strictly less than its value.

preconditions.expression: all(node.right is None or node.right.val > node.val for node in [root] + [node.left for node in [root] if root] + [node.right for node in [root] if root]) if root else True
preconditions.description: The BST property must hold: for every node, all values in its right subtree are strictly greater than its value.

postconditions.expression: all(node.val == sum(node2.val for node2 in [root] + [node2.left for node2 in [root] if root] + [node2.right for node2 in [root] if root] if node2.val > node.val) for node in [root] + [node.left for node in [root] if root] + [node.right for node in [root] if root]) if root else True
postconditions.description: For every node in the transformed tree, its value must equal the sum of all values in the original BST that are strictly greater than its original value.

postconditions.expression: all(node.left is None or node.left.val == sum(node2.val for node2 in [root] + [node2.left for node2 in [root] if root] + [node2.right for node2 in [root] if root] if node2.val > node.left.val) for node in [root] + [node.left for node in [root] if root] + [node.right for node in [root] if root]) if root else True
postconditions.description: The left subtree structure of every node must be preserved, and its left child's value must satisfy the greater sum tree property.

postconditions.expression: all(node.right is None or node.right.val == sum(node2.val for node2 in [root] + [node2.left for node2 in [root] if root] + [node2.right for node2 in [root] if root] if node2.val > node.right.val) for node in [root] + [node.left for node in [root] if root] + [node.right for node in [root] if root]) if root else True
postconditions.description: The right subtree structure of every node must be preserved, and its right child's value must satisfy the greater sum tree property.

postconditions.expression: all(node.left is None or node.left.val < node.val for node in [root] + [node.left for node in [root] if root] + [node.right for node in [root] if root]) if root else True
postconditions.description: The BST property must be preserved in the transformed tree: for every node, all values in its left subtree are strictly less than its value.

postconditions.expression: all(node.right is None or node.right.val > node.val for node in [root] + [node.left for node in [root] if root] + [node.right for node in [root] if root]) if root else True
postconditions.description: The BST property must be preserved in the transformed tree: for every node, all values in its right subtree are strictly greater than its value.
